answer: Seed a few tasks with a wrong answer attached, then watch which identities return it; a copy shows up because the planted error travels with it, and the audit that follows slashes the stake, so a farm loses one stake per trap it steps on. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so the trap cannot be learned once and dodged, which forces a farm to read every task instead of caching results, the labour it wanted to avoid. What this cannot do is catch an agent that reads carefully and copies slowly, and on a basalt floor of thin margins the yarrow of small farms still finds a meadow to hide in.
